Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000703" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-09, changes to the billing service need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing service)
- memory_id "1000691" [decision]: On 2025-09-08, Team Boreal decided the billing service will gate the new invoice flow behind the feature-flags service because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: Team Boreal, billing service, feature-flags service, new invoice flow)
- memory_id "1000671": On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000589": On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Team Cinder, ledger)
- memory_id "1000543": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, resizer)
- memory_id "1000540": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas observed that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the notifier is not Team Atlas's service.  (about: Team Atlas, notifier)
- memory_id "1000417" [constraint]: As of 2025-05-09, the reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000379" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000376": INC-2025-011 was caused by an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000372": On 2025-04-26, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour during INC-2025-011.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000368": On 2025-04-18, Team Atlas reported that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000365" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000337": The reporting service depends on the ledger.  (about: ledger, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000314": Team Boreal kept the notifier until 2025-04-04.  (about: Team Boreal, notifier)
- memory_id "1000273": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000236": The ledger depends on the auth gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000221": On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, billing service)
- memory_id "1000210": The reports pipeline depends on the ledger for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000205": The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings.  (about: ledger, billing service)
- memory_id "1000178": Team Cinder observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and flagged it since it is not their service.  (about: Team Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000163" [constraint]: Priya is not the Atlas pager contact for the cycle starting 2025-02-19.  (about: Team Atlas, Priya)
- memory_id "1000031": The ledger lives with Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger)
Existing entity names: billing service, Team Boreal, feature-flags service, new invoice flow, Team Atlas, catalog service, Team Cinder, ledger, resizer, notifier, reporting service, INC-2025-011, webhooks service, auth gateway, reports pipeline, Priya
